Embedding batch assigns results without dimension/count/finite validation;short batch can omit items while marking batchDone. Cosine loops first vector length only,zero norm returns0,dimension mismatch may NaN/asymmetric;not runtime reproduced. Subgroup membership accepts duplicates/overlap and may leave omitted items stale duplicateGroup;no executed counterexample yet. VectorStore connect asynchronous not awaited before large-set use;implementation pending.

Three authored controls executed original class body with dependency adapters:chain endpoints cosine0.5 appear together under0.8 edge threshold;short successful batch silently omits item without fallback;LLM subgroup excludes item3 but leaves its duplicateGroup0. No actual provider/vectorstore/concurrency qualification;two harness setup failures corrected before successful execution.

Both dedup unit test files whole-read:6verification+11core/cross-type cases,not executed. Subgroup test checks returned members but never cleared duplicateGroup of excluded singleton,so reproduced stale-label issue passes its stated assertions. Batch tests cover full response/rejection,not successful short response. Failure test expects18 calls due real controller retry;current adapter controls explicitly do not qualify retries. No transitive endpoint threshold/NaN/dimension mismatch or duplicate numeric ID cases in these files.

VectorStore whole-read. No normalization or exact cosine rerank;uses1-distance/2 assuming normalized vectors,missing distance defaults0=>similarity1. Two original-class adapter controls confirm transformation behavior with synthetic rows (collinear unequal-length vectors supplied L2sq4 reject;absent distance accepts1). Actual LanceDB metric behavior not tested.

findAllPairs queries limit20 per record incl self,no pagination or completeness check;cannot promise every above-threshold pair. No explicit ANN index creation visible,so source comment O(nlogn) unqualified. upsert drops shared table then creates,not transactional replacement;failure/concurrent readers untested. close merely nulls reference,not observed explicit database close.
